title: Passive Turtle Scute
description: Turtles passively drop Turtle Scute every 7.5 minutes (on average) instead of needing to be bred.
body:
Turtles now shed scute similar to how Armadillos do. 

The drop-rate of one Turtle Scute every 7.5 minutes matches the Armadillo Scute and Chicken Egg drop-rates.

Saves you from convoluted methods of breeding, hatching, following, and waiting for Baby Turtles to grow up.

Supports Multiplayer.

Made for Java 1.21.6.
